gateToolingFinding.finding: The adapter sets selected videoSha256 only when exactly one MP4 is exported. All six historical normalized full snapshots retain multiple MP4 exports. The revised pair retain silent, unmastered and mastered files. This causes RENDER_VIDEO_MISMATCH even though the final video.mp4 matches its recorded hash.
gateToolingFinding.interpretation: This is a structural selection limitation, not evidence that the saved final MP4 changed. Repair it prospectively and verify exact final-video selection without deleting preserved intermediate exports. Fixing it cannot supply missing listening, other review scopes or teaching briefs.

codeFixAddendum.scope: Prospective gate adapter correction after the original read-only audit. Historical observations above are retained as recorded before this change.
codeFixAddendum.selection: Select only the unique tracked MP4 export whose SHA-256 equals the exact videoSha256 recorded in the hashed render record. No filename or export-count fallback.

reviewBoundaries: The teacher's general good feedback and script approval are not package-specific full listening approval for revised paced exports.
Human listening pending is a release blocker even when media statistics and sampled frames pass.
The full-render-unreviewed render-record status describes render provenance. The separate full-package review gate determines release readiness.
Current shared-code drift does not establish mutation of historical uploaded MP4s. Preserve old packages and their evidence.
Live visibility, HD processing and captions must be verified by root before any publication statement. This audit reads saved state only.
